name: WittyTuner
summary: Live TV and recording: network tuners, IPTV playlists, capture cards and guide data. Encrypted channels are refused.
needs: FFmpeg, which comes with the server
A tuner or an IPTV playlist
updates: All of it: every kind of tuner, finding them, reading their channels, scanning, and opening a stream.
stays: Recording and the guide stay with the server, and so does refusing encrypted channels, on purpose: the server watches every stream itself.
